wound_authority: Pre-Pitchess absolute confidentiality of peace officer personnel records; California Government Code § 6254(c) personnel records exemption as applied to officer files; absence of criminal discovery mechanism for police personnel records
in_force_period: From the establishment of California's public records and personnel confidentiality framework until July 25, 1974
superseded_by: Pitchess v. Superior Court, 11 Cal.3d 531 (1974); codified in Cal. Evid. Code §§ 1043-1047 (Stats. 1978); further expanded by SB 1421 (Stats. 2018, Ch. 988, effective January 1, 2019)
current_status: SUPERSEDED — absolute confidentiality framework no longer operative. Qualified discovery right established by Pitchess and codification. Mandatory disclosure categories established by SB 1421.

purpose_of_preservation: Defensive historical record — accurate citation of the legal wound that Pitchess and SB 1421 addressed. Demonstrates what access rights had to be fought for and why they matter.
